fact: Daba Finance says Fusepay operates in Seychelles with a Payment Service Provider licence and central bank approval.
The Central Bank of Seychelles gave Fusepay final approval to operate as a licensed Payment Service Provider.

Governor Caroline Abel said Seychelles has achieved full interoperability among banks on its most used payment systems, the Seychelles Electronic Funds Transfer and the Electronic Cheque Clearing systems, under an Act governing the operation and oversight of national payment systems.
Governor Abel said Seychelles processes cross-border payments through the Central Bank on the SADC-RTGS platform, with volumes too limited to bring in the commercial banks.
